name: Ugajima Yukari
source:
The school’s serial killer, who's still a student.

She casually stabs people with a knife, but since she can bring the victims back to life, it isn’t murder in the true sense of the word.

She offers advice from the perspective of a serial killer to Soraoka Yuuhi, who is working to solve the case that has to potential to turn into a real murder investigation.
